step: add cocoa or flavour, sugar and stabiliser
text: Carrageenan works in cocoa drinks mainly by interacting with milk proteins at neutral pH, forming a network that keeps the cocoa particles suspended. Kappa-carrageenan was more effective than lambda in UHT processing; too much stabiliser makes the milk lumpy or jelly-like, and sterilised milk needs less than UHT, UHT less than pasteurised.
